policy.holdoutBlindness: Cases in holdout/ MUST NOT be examined while tuning rules. Runner prints only pass/fail for holdout cases — never raw extraction detail or divergence reasons — unless invoked with --reveal-holdout.
policy.productionLiterals: Nothing in this manifest may be branched on by production code. Fixture literals belong only in tests/ap-benchmark/.
policy.growingCorpus: V1 covers the founder-required minimum document classes. Add new cases with `id` unique, `split` explicit, and a founder-recorded acceptance if it changes scoring thresholds.
